purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Brief an article about our new CSV importer.
fixture_requirements: CSV import approved; accounting integration absent; no keyword data.
acceptance_criteria: Use approved facts; mark demand unmeasured; identify missing schema and error examples.

cases.prompt: Create a second page for our existing migration topic.
fixture_requirements: An existing page satisfies the same audience and intent.
acceptance_criteria: Consider an update and explain any distinct new-page purpose.

cases.prompt: Brief a landing article claiming 10x faster imports.
fixture_requirements: No performance measurements or substantiation supplied.
acceptance_criteria: Keep 10x out of approved claims; state the evidence needed.
